speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of greasy yellow scales on the scalp and forehead in a 3-month-old infant is highly characteristic of infantile seborrheic dermatitis, often referred to as cradle cap. Given the classic presentation and the patient's age, this diagnosis fits the clinical picture better than psoriasis, despite the family history. DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile seborrheic dermatitis
